title: SvgCircle
responsibility: Renders the native circle element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgCircle.attributes
inputs.description: Native circle attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgCircle.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native circle element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgCircle
outputs.description: The actual native circle element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
